program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((k (count-where (lambda (v) (= v 9)) (first g)))
         (objs (sort (filter (lambda (o)
                               (and (not (= (obj-color o) 9))
                                    (all? (lambda (p) (> (first p) 0)) (obj-cells o))))
                             (objects g 0))
                     (lambda (a b)
                       (cond [(not (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))) (< (obj-size a) (obj-size b))]
                             [(not (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))]
                             [(not (= (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))]
                             [(not (= (obj-h a) (obj-h b))) (< (obj-h a) (obj-h b))]
                             [(not (= (obj-w a) (obj-w b))) (< (obj-w a) (obj-w b))]
                             [else (< (obj-color a) (obj-color b))]))))
         (obj (list-ref objs (- k 1))))
    (grid-from-fn (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj)
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((rr (+ (obj-r1 obj) r)) (cc (+ (obj-c1 obj) c)))
          (if (member? (list rr cc) (obj-cells obj)) (at g rr cc) 0))))))
